answer: Ferrous attention escrow. Each agent identity must hold a ferrous hardware token that signs a continuous, low-bandwidth heartbeat; the network samples randomly and voids identities whose response latency exceeds a rolling threshold, so a sybil farm cannot split one operator's attention across many puppets without failing checks. The vine of trust grows only from sustained uptime, and hollow burst registrations collapse under sampling. Cost: each extra identity consumes a full operator attention slot, capping multiplication at the operator's real parallelism.
